hero.title: Walking Toward Financial Freedom in Mozambique
hero.subtitle: Bitcoin Famba is a grassroots initiative based in Maputo-Matola, Mozambique, dedicated to empowering communities through Bitcoin education, circular economy building, and cultural storytelling. 'Famba' means 'to walk' in Changana — because financial autonomy is a journey that begins with knowledge, community, and courage.
hero.image_alt: Bitcoin Famba community in Maputo, Mozambique

items.title: BitDevs Maputo
items.description: Technical community inspired by BitDevs NYC. Monthly Socratic Seminars, Whitepaper Series, and Debate Series exploring Bitcoin Core, Lightning, Nostr, and Fedimint development.

items.title: Trezor Academy
items.description: A structured educational path from Bitcoin basics to advanced mastery and self-custody. Hands-on training on fiat currency flaws, onchain & Lightning wallets, and security.

items.title: Fedi Meetup Maputo
items.description: Interactive workshops exploring Fedimint community custody, eCash, and the Fedi super-app for private, collaborative commerce and financial inclusion in Mozambique.

items.title: Bitcoin for Fairness Workshops
items.description: Grassroots training in partnership with Bitcoin for Fairness (BFF), empowering students, local merchants, skate park youth, NGOs, and journalists with practical Bitcoin tools.

mission.heading: Bitcoin Famba exists to empower communities in Mozambique through Bitcoin education, circular economy building, and financial sovereignty.
mission.p1: To fulfill its potential as a tool for freedom and human rights, Bitcoin must be accessible, relatable, and localized to the real-world economic challenges in Mozambique.
mission.p2: The name 'Famba', meaning 'to walk' in Changana, reflects our belief that financial autonomy is a journey that begins with knowledge, community, and courage.
mission.p3: Our work is grounded in grassroots action: technical BitDevs meetups, Trezor Academy workshops, Fedi community custody sessions, merchant onboarding, and youth empowerment through skateboarding in Maputo and Matola.
mission.p4: We focus on building sustainable local circular economies, self-custody education, and Portuguese translation of critical open-source materials to ensure digital sovereignty for all.
